clips.name: scene1
clips.prompt: Early evening inside a small Japanese apartment living room. Ceiling light and a wall-mounted air conditioner are on, late afternoon light through the window. No people, no text, no letters, no logos, no product packaging. Quiet still atmosphere, static camera with a slow slight push-in. Photorealistic, cinematic, soft shadows. No background music, quiet room tone only.
